What are the VMT questions in system command virtual machine ?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: VMT questions are for your practice once you have gained some knowledge about bash. These carry activity points, helpful when you register for internships/jobs in placement and activity cell (IIC). These are a different level of questions when compared to OPPE. For OPPE practice, solve other questions named practice, PA, OPPE, etc.

posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@21f3000759
So level of questions for OPPE will not be like VMT questions, right ??
Please clarify my confusion ???

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
24f1002789:

So level of questions for OPPE will not be like VMT questions, right ??

No, definitely not. OPPE questions are not like VMT questions.
